description: Curated macOS CVE database for offline vulnerability detection and exploit mapping

entries.title: macOS ImageIO Buffer Overflow Vulnerability (BLASTPASS Zero-Click)
entries.description: A buffer overflow flaw in ImageIO allows remote attackers to execute arbitrary code with kernel privileges via crafted image files (exploited in Pegasus spyware deployments).
entries.remediation: Update to macOS Sonoma 14.0 or apply macOS Ventura 13.5.2 / macOS Security Response immediately.

entries.title: Apple XNU Kernel Hardware MMIO State Manipulation (Operation Triangulation)
entries.description: Attackers can bypass page table hardware security registers by writing directly to undocumented MMIO hardware registers in the Apple Silicon processor.
entries.remediation: Upgrade to macOS Ventura 13.5 or macOS Sonoma 14.0.

entries.title: Apple Kernel Memory Corruption Vulnerability
entries.description: An attacker with arbitrary kernel read and write capability may be able to bypass kernel memory protections.
entries.remediation: Update to macOS Sonoma 14.4 or later.

entries.title: Apple WebKit Memory Corruption Remote Code Execution
entries.description: Processing web content may lead to arbitrary code execution due to a memory corruption flaw in WebKit.
entries.remediation: Apply Safari 17.1.2 or macOS Sonoma 14.2 update.

entries.title: Apple CoreGraphics Type Confusion Arbitrary Code Execution
entries.description: An issue was addressed in CoreGraphics where parsing a crafted document could lead to unexpected process termination or arbitrary code execution.
entries.remediation: Update to macOS Sonoma 14.5 or macOS Sequoia 15.0.

entries.title: Apple PackageKit Directory Traversal & SIP Bypass
entries.description: A logic issue in PackageKit allowed an unprivileged application to bypass System Integrity Protection (SIP) restrictions via path traversal during package extraction.
entries.remediation: Update macOS to version 14.5 or later.
